text_block_list.name: Mother with Baby
text_block_list.text:
Kyaah! Kitasan Black-san!
U-Um, I'm always cheering for you!!

text_block_list.name: Mother with Baby
text_block_list.text:
Um, if you don't mind...
could you do a "Haaan~♪" for me?
I just love how that sounds...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, piece of cake!
Here goes~...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh no...! I got carried away with my momentum!
I-I'm so sooorryyy~~!

Feeling terribly sorry for making the baby cry,
Kitasan Black desperately tried to soothe them.
